name: titan-hq-tonal-readability
description: Verify the Titan wall and HQ retain a dark sci-fi identity while exposing a bounded, non-interactive hierarchy of panels, insets, seams, edge highlights, and two-stage weak-point brackets.

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.PolishConfig) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local presentation=root.Polish["World Presentation"] local titan=presentation.TitanHQ local boss=root.Walls["Titan Server Wall"] local tier=root.Polish["Wall Tier Frames"] local roles={} local parts=0 local safe=true local forbidden=0 for _,d in ipairs(titan:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts+=1 local role=d:GetAttribute("VisualRole") roles[role]=(roles[role] or 0)+1 safe=safe and d.Anchored and not d.CanCollide and not d.CanTouch and not d.CanQuery elseif d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then forbidden+=1 end end local function l(c) return c.R*.2126+c.G*.7152+c.B*.0722 end local settings=cfg.WorldPresentation local style=cfg.WallTiers["Titan Server Wall"] local weakPoints,weakClicks=0,0 for index=1,boss:GetAttribute("WeakPointCount") or 0 do local weak=tier:FindFirstChild("Titan Weak Point "..index) if weak then weakPoints+=1 if weak:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") then weakClicks+=1 end end end local gameplay=boss.Size==Vector3.new(34,18,6) and boss.CanCollide and boss:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")~=nil and weakPoints==3 and weakClicks==3 local tonal=l(boss.Color)>=.20 and l(settings.TitanPanel)-l(settings.TitanInset)>=.07 and l(settings.TitanMetal)-l(settings.TitanPanel)>=.07 and l(settings.TitanEdge)-l(settings.TitanMetal)>=.18 and l(settings.TitanAccent)-l(settings.TitanInset)>=.20 and l(settings.TitanWeakPointAccent)-l(settings.TitanPanel)>=.35 local hierarchy=(roles.TitanFacadePanel or 0)==4 and (roles.TitanFacadeInset or 0)==4 and (roles.TitanFacadeSeam or 0)==4 and (roles.TitanFacadeEdge or 0)==4 local weakFrames=(roles.TitanWeakPointBracket or 0)==weakPoints*4 and (roles.TitanWeakPointCorner or 0)==weakPoints*4 local budget=(presentation:GetAttribute("DecorativePartCount") or 0)<=(presentation:GetAttribute("DecorativePartBudget") or 0) and parts==(presentation:GetAttribute("TitanHQPartCount") or -1) and parts<=52 local function colorDistance(a,b) return Vector3.new(a.R-b.R,a.G-b.G,a.B-b.B).Magnitude end local wallTone=colorDistance(boss.Color,style.color)<.001 and colorDistance(boss:GetAttribute("OriginalColor"),style.color)<.001 return H:JSONEncode({version=presentation:GetAttribute("TitanTonalContractVersion"),validated=presentation:GetAttribute("TitanTonalContrastValidated"),tonal=tonal,hierarchy=hierarchy,weakFrames=weakFrames,budget=budget,titanParts=parts,safe=safe,forbidden=forbidden,gameplay=gameplay,wallTone=wallTone,runtimeLoops=presentation:GetAttribute("ContainsRuntimeLoops"),lights=presentation:GetAttribute("ContainsLightsOrParticles"),roles=roles})

steps.label: Titan tonal hierarchy is readable bounded and gameplay-neutral
